WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

scatters.name: STACK SPINS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 In the Stack Spins feature you have a higher chance of landing both types of Stackways™ symbols.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 extra spins, 3 FS symbols awards 4 extra spins.

scatters.name: SUPER STACK SPINS
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 In the Super Stack Spins feature you have a higher chance of landing Stackways™ symbols. Only the revealing Stackways™ symbol appears in this feature!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 extra spins, 3 FS symbols awards 4 extra spins.

specials.name: STACKWAYS™
specials.behavior:
Land the Stackways™ symbol on a reel to fill that reel with a stacked amount of paying symbols equal to the number displayed. Between 2 to 10 symbols can be stacked on each reel.

 There are two types of Stackways™ symbols:

 Normal Stackways™ symbols with the possible values: 2, 3, 4

 Revealing Stackways™ symbols with the possible values: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

 The symbol that is stacked is determined by choosing the symbol that would grant the longest winning combination based on the symbols present on the reels when the Stackways™ symbol activates. If more than one winning combination of equal length could be created, the symbol will be chosen randomly. The stacking only occurs when the result would create a winning combination.
